subject.title: fix(zalo): prevent Bot API requests from hanging

question: Should Zalo media-bearing send methods retain a longer bounded deadline than ordinary API calls, or is a hard 30-second failure for all existing Zalo sends the intended product contract?
rationale: The patch changes a shared transport boundary and the correct deadline depends on the intended delivery contract for slow uploads; source and proof supplied here do not establish that product choice.

options.title: Use endpoint-specific bounded deadlines
options.body: Keep the 30-second default for ordinary API calls while giving media upload methods a documented, tested longer bounded deadline.

options.title: Accept the universal 30-second contract
options.body: Land the universal deadline only with explicit owner approval and upgrade-facing evidence that failed slow media sends are acceptable.

recommendation.title: Use endpoint-specific bounded deadlines
recommendation.body: Keep the 30-second default for ordinary API calls while giving media upload methods a documented, tested longer bounded deadline.

likelyOwner.reason: A Zalo-area owner is needed, but the available read-only environment could not complete the required history attribution.
